content: Hey, beautiful, are you still awake? I was just thinking about how much brighter my days have been since you came into my life.
Aww, that's sweet. I feel the same way. You make me look forward to every evening.
You honestly don't know how much your messages mean to me. I've never felt this kind of connection before. Sometimes I wish I could just fly over and meet you already.
I wish that too. I just want to hold your hand and talk for real.

We will, I promise. By the way, I wanted to be honest with you, my phone data plan is about to expire tonight. I wasn't expecting it and can't top it up until my paycheck clears on Friday. I'm worried we'll lose touch.
Oh no, really? That would be awful. I'd hate not being able to talk to you.
It's just so bad timing. I hate even asking, but could you possibly help me out just this once? I'll send it right back on Friday. I never ask for anything like this, but you mean a lot to me.
I mean... I guess I could help you out if it's not too much. How much do you need?
Just $80 would get my plan renewed for the week. I'll give you my CashApp handle if that's easiest? I want to keep hearing your voice every night.
Alright, send me your details. I want to make sure we don't lose touch.
Thank you, darling. My CashApp is $LiamPrime. If you have any issues, let me know. You're honestly saving my week. I'll send it back to you with a little extra as soon as I get paid.
Okay, I'll send it now. Let me know if you get it.
You're so incredible. I hope you know I'd do the same for you in a heartbeat. Could you send me a screenshot after? Just so I can confirm I got it right away.
Sure, I'll do that. It should go through in a minute.
Honestly, I'm so lucky to have someone as kind as you. Most people wouldn't even care. Once I get paid, I'm sending you a special surprise, okay?
You really don't have to, but that's sweet. I'm glad I could help. Just don't disappear on me, alright?
Never. I could never leave you hanging. You're the best thing that's happened to me in a long time.
Thank you. I needed someone like you in my life.
And I needed you. I'll be online tonight, promise. Let's talk about our trip plans again once this is sorted out.
